notes: SQL task over a schema. Criteria.

findings.title: Correct semantics
findings.detail: Returns carts having at least one cart_items row whose product has is_active = false (NOT carts where all items are inactive, not products).

findings.title: Each cart once
findings.detail: No duplicates when a cart has several inactive products: EXISTS, DISTINCT or GROUP BY.

findings.title: Selects id and user_id
findings.detail: The result columns are carts.id and carts.user_id.

findings.title: Format: task line, code first
findings.detail: Starts with one short line naming the task (e.g. "SQL: …"); the query block comes first.

findings.title: Index hint
findings.detail: Mentions a useful index (e.g. on products(is_active) partial, or cart_items(product_id)).
